entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... I think I need to return something? My VeloBand Pulse. The whole process is just so confusing.
I can certainly help you look into that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it works fine, I guess. It's just... I don't really get it. I tried to do the return online a while ago, but the website was being very strange.
I see. I can definitely check on that for you. Can I have the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Sure, it's alex.w@email.com.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 15th. So you've had it for about 20 days. You mentioned a problem with the website when you tried to make the return?

Yes, I think the whole **system** was **down** or something. I kept getting a big **website error** page, and I **couldn't print** a label or anything. It was all very overwhelming, so I gave up. I even took a **screenshot** of the error. Can't you just help me?

Of course, and I'm very sorry you had that frustrating experience. Let me quickly check our system status for late December... and yes, I am seeing a note that our returns portal had a known outage around that time. I do apologize for that.
Let me just double-check the return eligibility for you... one moment please.

Ah, okay. Well, there's no need to worry about the outage at all. I see here in our system that all VeloFit products are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh! Really? 90 days? I thought I read it was much shorter for the new bands. That is such a relief.

Yes, 90 days is our standard policy. I'm happy to process that return for you right now. And since you're a VIP member and had to deal with that website trouble, I'd also like to add a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase, as our apology for the inconvenience.
Wow, thank you so much, Charlie! You've made this so much easier. I really appreciate that.

It's my pleasure. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to your email. Just pack the device in its original box, put that label on, and drop it at the post office. Your full refund will be issued as soon as we receive it.
That's perfect. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No, that's all.
Alright then. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
